page.overview:
What is Masrani Global Corporation?

The Masrani Global Corporation, also known as Masrani Corporation or Masrani Global, is a diverse multinational corporation. The company has concentrated efforts in telecommunication, oil, and bioengineering sectors.

Founded in 1973 by Sanjay Masrani, the company initially established itself in the telecommunications sector. By 1983, ten years after their start-up, the company perfected the technology Mascom, becoming a household name with forty-five channels all over India. Sanjay himself died in 1992 and the company was passed down to his son, Simon Masrani. By 1996, Masrani Global had moved into the oil industry, with rigs concentrated in Abu Dhabi.

After the untimely death of John Hammond in 1997, Masrani bought InGen and began developing Jurassic World, a theme park on the Costa Rican island Isla Nublar. Following the incident, the company was forced to pay off $800 million in damages and lawsuits from the survivors of the incident.

Additonally, COO Richard Wiesner sent a letter to Masrani's investors telling them not to panic and that the company was going to have an urgent board meeting.

Also known as: Masrani, Masrani Global.
